text.description_html:
Acorn AKJBP, 13-3/8 Inch Black Stainless Steel Bean Tip Shutter Hinge

Acorn's Bean Tip Shutter Hinge features an old world design that is perfect for traditional homes. The black finish only heightens the sense of antiquity, making it perfect for historic home restoration projects or if you just want to add a bit of rustic beauty. Made out of stainless steel, it comes packaged with one hinge, one pintle, and matching fasteners. The 13-3/8 Inch Bean Tip Shutter Hinge is reversible.

Features and Specifications of the Bean Tip Shutter Hinge:

  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Length: 13-3/8"
  • Flush
  • Reversible
  • Packaged Includes: 1 hinge, pintle and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

Sold Individually (1 hinge). Recommended 2 hinges per shutter so 4 hinges per window.
